detail.longDescription: I just released PostSquire, an open-source, local-first Go TUI for preparing coordinated social campaign handoffs. It reads reviewable JSON, validates platform-ready copy, and opens browser composers or a private local pasteboard. It never stores social credentials, calls publishing APIs, schedules posts, or presses Publish. Take a look, try it, and let me know what you think: https:// gitlab.com/IndianaTux/postsqui re # OpenSource # Golang # SocialMedia # TUI
